motive.zhHans: Matsuo 把 Suwa 叫了出来，因为他骗 Suwa 以为自己想自杀。当时人在储藏室上一层房间的 Matsuo，从窗户朝正下方开枪——因为 Suwa 已经探身窗外足够远。由于那扇窗可以沿水平中轴翻转，翻回来时把被害人推回了房间内，于是看起来就像凶手是从房间门内开枪，而不是从窗户上方开的枪。
motive.en: Matsuo called Suwa, because he tricked him into thinking that he wanted to kill himself. Matsuo, who has been in a floor above the storage room had, from the window shot his gun vertically below because Suwa has leaned far enough out of the window. Because the window can be tilted along a horizontal central axis, it returned the victim back in to the room, making it look as if the offender had shot him from inside the room from the door and not from above the window in the room.

method.zhHans: Matsuo 把 Suwa 叫了出来，因为他骗 Suwa 以为自己想自杀。同时他把作案用的枪丢下，让枪和被害人一同落进房间。柯南通过模拟自己从窗口坠落的方式，还原了整个作案过程。
method.en: Matsuo called Suwa, because he tricked him into thinking that he wanted to kill himself. At the same time he dropped the gun he used, allowing it fall into the room along with the victim. Conan reconstructed the crime by pretending to fall out the window.

evidence.zhHans: 证据是手机上的通话记录：按下他手机的重拨键就会拨通 Suwa，这说明他在作案期间给 Suwa 打过电话。
evidence.en: The call log on the phone is the proof, hitting the redial on his phone would call Suwa which meant that he had called Suwa during the crime.

resolution.zhHans: 柯南把小五郎 骗进储藏室，用手表型麻醉枪让他睡着，借来一把彩弹枪，让熟睡的小五郎出现在电视画面上，与警方演出了一场「现场直播」。
resolution.en: Conan deceives Kogoro, gets him in the storage room, puts him to sleep with his stun gun wristwatch, borrows a paint gun, and stages a "Live Show" with the sleeping Kogoro appearing before the police on a television screen.

summary.en: The TV presenter Takashi Matsuo calls his colleague, Michihiko Suwa, and tells him that he wants to meet him after the show in the conference room. Matsuo hangs a photo of himself and Suwa, throws it across the room, and shoots it with a gun.
